episodes.title: I'm in a Hurry
episodes.summary: Elizabeth Holmes, an optimistic and determined young woman, drops out of Stanford to find a promising new blood-testing startup.

episodes.title: Satori
episodes.summary: In need of money, Elizabeth brings her fledgling technology to the venture capitalists of Silicon Valley. In Switzerland, she is forced to make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Green Juice
episodes.summary: As Theranos rapidly expands, Elizabeth's technology struggles to keep pace and members of the board become increasingly wary of her secretive behavior. Sunny considers joining the company.

episodes.title: Old White Men
episodes.summary: Walgreens is enticed by Elizabeth to seal the deal on a new partnership with Theranos. Ian tries to investigate what's going on behind closed doors.

episodes.title: Flower of Life
episodes.summary: With the Walgreens deadline looming, Elizabeth and Sunny scramble to find solutions to their technological failures. Ian is drawn into Elizabeth's lawsuit against Richard.

episodes.title: Iron Sisters
episodes.summary: Fresh out of college and newly employed by Theranos, Tyler Schultz and Erika Cheung discover shocking truths about Elizabeth and the company. Richard and Phyllis work with John Carreyrou to build a case against Elizabeth.

episodes.title: Heroes
episodes.summary: Under intense scrutiny from the Wall Street Journal, Elizabeth and Sunny double down on defense. Tyler and Erika face a difficult choice.

episodes.title: Lizzy
episodes.summary: In the wake of the Wall Street Journal article, Elizabeth and Sunny face a reckoning.
